pinnedFiles.reason: The existing `loom docs` command family (plan/approve/apply) that `docs check` must extend; shows the cobra.Command + init() registration pattern this feature's new subcommand follows.
Existing test conventions for `loom docs` subcommands (captured IO, repo fixtures) that the new `docs check` command's tests should match.
Reusable pattern for splitting a leading YAML frontmatter fence from a markdown body (splitFrontmatter) — directly applicable to AC2's requirement to ignore frontmatter.
Existing Issue type (File/Field/Message/Severity, String() renders "file: field: message") — the closest in-repo precedent for the `file:line: rule: excerpt` finding format AC1 requires.

The actual data file the check must read; shows the real markdown table shape (bold Term, Description, "Synonyms to AVOID" column with comma-separated entries and parenthetical notes) that AC5's parser must handle.

The normative rule this feature mechanizes — the analyst must map each bullet (sentence length, active voice, noun clusters, modals, plain vocabulary, one-term-one-meaning) to a specific, deterministic check or an explicit 'left for a reviewer' note.

Distance-independent prior delivery in the same Owning Context (Documentation Knowledge Base) — no retrospective.md exists for it, so there are no What-Went-Poorly/What-To-Improve lessons to carry forward, but it shows how a prior doc-tooling feature in this context scoped its Technical Breakdown.

pruned: internal/genblock/genblock.go — handles loom:generated hash-marker blocks, not prose fenced-code-span detection; different concern despite surface similarity to 'ignore fenced code'.
internal/testlint/module.go — Go-AST 'test can fail' linter; belongs to Craftsmanship Governance/test tooling, a different bounded context than this doc-prose checker.
internal/repodoc/vocabulary.go — loads a YAML tag vocabulary with project-level override; DOMAIN_DICTIONARY.md is a fixed-path markdown table, not YAML, so the loading shape doesn't transfer.

shared/contracts/analysis-contract.md and internal/state/analysis_state.go — the analyst's own output contract/schema; under `loom run` this is appended automatically as the invocation's OUTPUT CONTRACT, so pinning it here would be redundant.

docs/adrs/ADR-001-adopt-rag-friendly-docs-structure.md — about docs directory structure, not prose writing-style mechanics; no KI or ADR specifically about Simplified Technical English enforcement was found in shared/knowledge or docs/adrs.
